baseline_models.focus_anchor: The direct collision between تُحَرِّمُ and أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah opposes two boundary-making acts: a human act of prevention and the divine removal of prohibition. The question challenges not desire itself but a reversal of jurisdiction in which the addressee installs a bar over what divine authority has left open.

activation_trace.role: Prevention and prohibition supply the human boundary-making act under interrogation.
The dissolution of a ban supplies the contrary divine act that leaves the object accessible.
Worship and the worshipped ground the permission in divine rather than household jurisdiction.

changed_reading.before: The addressee merely gives up something personally permissible.
changed_reading.after: The addressee has begun to install a binding boundary over a domain that divine authority has already unbarred.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَاجِكَ links seeking, satisfaction, and spouses to the act of prohibition.
baseline_models.mechanism: A sought change in another party's affect is purchased by deprivation of the self. Because the parties are paired, the restriction functions as relational currency: access to an allowed thing is surrendered to remove displeasure or obtain acceptance inside the household.

activation_trace.role: Active seeking makes spousal satisfaction the intended output of the restriction.
Seeking another's satisfaction and removing displeasure specify the affective transaction.
A counterpart joined to its mate supplies the coupled social system in which one act shifts both parties.
Deprivation and loss of the sought thing supply the price paid in the appeasement exchange.

changed_reading.before: The prohibition is a detached ascetic preference.
changed_reading.after: The prohibition is self-deprivation used to regulate displeasure within a coupled household relationship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacent ح ر م and ح ل ل roots support spatial and mechanical images in addition to legal labels.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can be pictured as a shared zone that God has opened by loosening a knot, after which the addressee redraws a protected perimeter around it. Pairing makes that redrawn perimeter relational rather than purely individual.

activation_trace.role: The sanctuary and its surrounding protected precinct turn prohibition into a spatial cordon.
Untying a knot supplies the opposed operation of loosening what had been fastened.
Joined counterparts make the opened or cordoned space a shared relational field.

changed_reading.before: Forbidden and allowed are static classifications.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages opposed operations on a shared boundary: divine untying followed by human re-cordoning.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A prophet is corrected inside a marital setting, but the ayah closes with غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The private act matters at the level of prophetic office, yet the closing movement is protective rather than expulsive. Covering the fault's effects and extending tenderness make correction serve restoration of both accountable agency and intimate relation.

activation_trace.role: The one who reports from God makes a private boundary choice consequential for prophetic office.
Marriage locates the correction inside an intimate bond rather than an abstract legal exercise.
Covering the fault and protecting its bearer from its effects supplies restorative containment.
Tenderness and beneficence turn rebuke toward repair rather than rupture.

changed_reading.before: The closing attributes are generic reassurance after a reprimand.
changed_reading.after: The reprimand itself is enclosed in a reparative process that protects office and relationship while correcting the act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel turns the abstract opposition of forbidding and allowing into a bounded legal operation: a specified obligation, a sworn bond, and its authorized release. Divine guardianship over the addressees locates the exit from self-binding under the same authority whose permission was overridden.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the imposed prohibition that needs a lawful exit.
Untying a knot gives the focus opposition a mechanical release image.
A precisely bounded imposition supplies the formal obligation side of the mechanism.
Release from an oath explicitly converts untying into the remedy for sworn self-binding.
The oath branch identifies the bond to which the release operation applies.
Undertaking and managing an affair assigns governance of the release to divine guardianship.

structural_cues: 66:2 immediately follows the question and repeats ح ل ل in تَحِلَّةَ while adding أَيْمَان.
The sequence moves from questioned prohibition to an already established release procedure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibition, bounded imposition, oath, release, and divine guardianship; I infer that the focus restriction was enacted through self-binding or functioned like a vow. A live alternative is that 66:2 gives a general remedy without identifying the exact form of the act in 66:1.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns an unspecified private abstention.
changed_reading.after: The abstention is read as a knot-like self-obligation for which divine law supplies an authorized untying.

context_deltas.mechanism: Secret speech becomes transmitted news, is exposed by God, and is then handled through selective disclosure and selective turning aside. The repeated prophetic news-root becomes operational rather than titular, recasting the household restriction as one move inside a breached and then deliberately managed information circuit.

activation_trace.role: Prophetic reporting anchors the later information circuit back in the focus address.
Purposeful seeking lets information management become a possible means of pursuing household peace.
Concealment in the interior supplies the private channel's initial state.
A report that arrives and is relayed supplies the repeated transmission events.
The hidden, low, ambiguous sound image preserves the covert signal quality beneath the overt reporting chain.
Speech renewed as report supplies the content that changes hands.
Emergence and disclosure reverse the secret's hidden state.
Recognition by an identifying trace supplies selective acknowledgment of part of the disclosure.
Turning one's side away supplies deliberate non-disclosure of the remaining part.

structural_cues: 66:3 alternates concealment, retransmission, divine exposure, partial acknowledgment, and partial omission.
The ن ب ء root occurs five times in 66:3 after naming the addressee by that root in 66:1.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a secret, its relay, its exposure, and calibrated partial disclosure; I infer that the focus prohibition may be a containment response inside a trust breach. The live alternative is adjacency without direct causation: the information episode may explain consequences rather than the original restriction.

changed_reading.before: The restriction is driven only by a spouse's preference.
changed_reading.after: The restriction can also be a conflict-management move inside a household where private signals leak, return as news, and require calibrated disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired household develops directional force: hearts incline, two parties can back one another, and that backing is counterweighted by a wider network of protectors. Seeking wives' satisfaction therefore becomes more than tenderness; it can transfer practical boundary-setting power to an intimate coalition.

activation_trace.role: Effort to remove another's displeasure supplies the focus's susceptibility to relational pressure.
Coupled counterparts supply the intimate system in which alignment and counter-alignment operate.
Inclination of the heart and loyalty supplies a directional vector within the pair.
The heart localizes that vector as affective and volitional rather than merely procedural.
Strength gained through another's back supplies coalition and counter-coalition support.
Love, aid, and alliance enlarge the field beyond the immediate spouses and counterbalance their pressure.

structural_cues: The dual forms in 66:4 make two household actors a possible aligned unit.
The verse answers that alignment with a layered protector network rather than with solitary resistance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart-inclination, dual backing, and countervailing protectors; I infer that appeasement in 66:1 risks conceding normative control to coalition pressure. A live alternative is that 66:4 describes only the later dispute and does not characterize the initial motive.

changed_reading.before: Pleasing the wives is a simple act of affection.
changed_reading.after: Pleasing the wives may be governance under intimate coalition pressure, with divine correction restoring a larger alignment of authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The current marital pairing is shown as a bond that can be released and replaced by another pairing selected for better qualities. That contingency prevents the present partners' satisfaction from becoming an ultimate jurisdiction while preserving marriage itself as a real joined relation.

activation_trace.role: The existing joined counterparts supply the relation whose authority is being tested.
Untying supplies the focus's mechanical vocabulary for release from an over-tightened arrangement.
Undoing the marriage bond makes the current pairing explicitly reversible.
Release from a restraint echoes the untying operation activated around divine allowance.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the replacement mechanism.
Making one party a counterpart to another rebuilds pairing after release.
Excellence and selection make qualities, not current approval alone, the criterion for re-pairing.

structural_cues: 66:5 retains the زوج vocabulary while placing divorce, substitution, and evaluated qualities around it.
The replacement remains hypothetical, so contingency rather than actual rupture does the interpretive work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release of marriage, substitution, renewed pairing, and qualitative preference; I infer that this exposes the non-absolute status of present spousal approval. A live alternative is that the threat disciplines the spouses without revising the logic of 66:1 itself.

changed_reading.before: The current wives' satisfaction is a fixed household constraint to which permission must bend.
changed_reading.after: The current pairing is real but contingent and answerable to qualities beyond its own internal approval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah does not dissolve boundaries indiscriminately. It relocates them from an allowed object to a destructive fire: households are to be enclosed by protection, while hard and strong agents enforce an actual divine command. The focus fault is therefore misdirected restriction and misassigned authority, not strictness as such.

activation_trace.role: A protected precinct supplies the focus's candidate boundary architecture.
Hardening and refusal of softness supply the severity that must be correctly targeted.
Repelling harm through protection supplies the legitimate purpose of a boundary.
The near group of belonging extends boundary responsibility from self to household.
Blazing fire supplies the actual danger against which access must be blocked.
Fuel material gives the danger a causal feedstock rather than leaving it a moral abstraction.
The stone-root's prevention and enclosure image turns household protection into a built perimeter.
Harshness in treatment supplies severity at the enforcement edge of the legitimate boundary.
Strength and solidity make that protective edge resistant rather than merely symbolic.
Binding command distinguishes authorized firmness from the focus's self-assigned prohibition.

structural_cues: The household field expands from spouses in 66:1 to selves and families in 66:6.
Protection, fire, fuel, hard guardians, and repeated command form a causal boundary system.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a command to protect household members, a destructive target, and hard obedient enforcers; I infer a contrast between misdirected and correctly directed restriction. A live alternative is that 66:6 introduces general responsibility without deliberately correcting the boundary image of 66:1.

changed_reading.before: The ayah rejects severity and prohibition in favor of permissiveness.
changed_reading.after: The ayah rejects a boundary aimed at what God allowed; later context relocates firm protection toward genuine harm and divine command.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing forgiveness of the focus expands into a material repair sequence: an unmixed return can stitch a tear, wrongdoing is covered away, moving light remains unfinished, a final piece completes the fabric, and forgiveness protects the repaired person. Correction aims at restored integrity, not merely cancellation of liability.

activation_trace.role: A covering that protects supplies the focus's initial restorative material image.
Tender beneficence gives the repair sequence its relational rather than merely forensic purpose.
Sewing and mending a tear turns sincere return into repair of a rupture.
Erasing wrongdoing by covering it supplies removal through protective concealment.
Light moving ahead supplies the restored capacity that is present but not yet complete.
A piece that completes weaving supplies the final integration of the repaired whole.
Covering fault and shielding its bearer from effects closes the repair arc with the focus root itself.

structural_cues: 66:8 orders sincere return, covering of wrongs, entry, moving light, requested completion, and requested forgiveness.
The focus's final غ ف ر root reappears as an explicit petition after the repair sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mending, covering, light, woven completion, and forgiveness; I supply the arrow that treats them as stages of one restorative process. A live alternative keeps the material branches separate and reads the sequence only in moral and eschatological terms.

changed_reading.before: غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ simply softens the rebuke.
changed_reading.after: The ending opens a repair program in which a household and moral tear can be stitched, covered, relit, and completed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same prophetic address later commands strenuous resistance and harsh dealing. Read against that command, the focus does not reject firmness; it diagnoses firmness applied inwardly to a divinely allowed object for intimate approval rather than outwardly under command against named opposition.

activation_trace.role: Prophetic office fixes the addressee whose use of firmness is being calibrated.
Hardening and preventing softness expose severity latent inside the focus prohibition.
The repeated prophetic address holds the agent constant while the commanded object changes.
Exerting full capacity under difficulty supplies authorized strenuous action.
Harshness in speech or treatment supplies the explicitly commanded firmness that contrasts with self-prohibition.

structural_cues: 66:1 and 66:9 share the exact direct address يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ.
The held-constant addressee allows object and authorization, rather than personality, to explain the opposite treatments.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated address, focus hardening, later strenuous action, and commanded harshness; I infer a calibration rule based on object and authority. A live alternative is that private and public missions are simply separate domains without deliberate contrast.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks the prophet to be generally softer.
changed_reading.after: The focus asks him to stop hardening the wrong boundary for the wrong authority; firmness remains valid when its target and command are aligned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired examples separate marital proximity from moral standing in both directions. Wives joined to righteous men can diminish trust and receive no salvific sufficiency from their husbands; a believing wife can build an alternative home near God and seek separation from an oppressive husband. Pairing joins agents without fusing their allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Joined counterparts anchor the claim that marriage creates relation without erasing two-ness.
Seeking a spouse's satisfaction supplies the approval whose normative reach the examples limit.
The woman as a distinct person keeps each wife visible as an accountable agent inside marriage.
Diminished fidelity and trust show that intimate proximity does not guarantee aligned allegiance.
Sufficiency supplies what even righteous husbands cannot provide on behalf of their wives.
The second wife-example preserves distinct personhood on the believing side of the mirror.
Building by joining parts supplies the constructive act of forming an alternative belonging.
Nearness and presence relocate the desired household toward God rather than the current spouse.
Shelter and dwelling give that alternative allegiance a concrete home.
Deliverance by separation supplies moral exit from husband and oppressive collective.

structural_cues: 66:10 and 66:11 are paired by the repeated formula that God sets forth an example, first for rejection and then for trust.
The first example denies transferred rescue through a righteous spouse; the second affirms independent fidelity against an unrighteous spouse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored wife-examples, failed spousal sufficiency, an alternative house, and deliverance by separation; I infer a symmetric limit on spousal approval as a source of norm. A live alternative is that the examples address final accountability without directly commenting on the household choice in 66:1.

changed_reading.before: The focus either blames wives' influence or treats marital affection as sufficient justification.
changed_reading.after: Marriage joins but does not merge moral agents: a spouse's satisfaction matters relationally but cannot confer, replace, or override divine standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a concrete sweet tree exudate is activated from a branch under the closing divine epithet, then read backward into the indefinite allowed object. It remains anchored in the focus because مَا leaves the object unspecified and the packet explicitly supplies this branch for غ ف ر. Downstream prose should call it an intra-ayah material resonance or candidate image, never an identification of the object or an imported occasion report.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The unspecified مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ occurs in the same ayah as غَفُورٌ.

activation_trace.role: Sweet arboreal exudates supply a concrete sticky or consumable image that can flow backward toward the unspecified allowed thing.
Removal of prohibition keeps the material candidate within the focus's allowed-object slot.
Seeking supplies the purposeful household response attached to relinquishing that possible object.
Removing another's displeasure gives the possible consumable image an intimate social function.

changed_reading.before: مَا names an entirely abstract and unrecoverable allowed object.
changed_reading.after: The closing root leaks a sweet plant-exudate image back into مَا, keeping a domestic consumable candidate live without fixing its identity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ح ل ي mapping for the surface classified under ح ل ل. It remains anchored in the exact focus word أَحَلَّ and in the spouse-pleasing construction. Downstream prose should present adornment as a secondary split-root resonance, not as the verb's translation or a replacement for the dominant legal reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَحَلَّ stands between prohibition and the pursuit of marital satisfaction and carries both packet targets.

activation_trace.role: Worn adornment and beautification supply a non-dominant image of the thing removed from use.
The dominant lifting of prohibition keeps the adornment resonance subordinate to legal permission.
Seeking another's satisfaction makes removal of an adornment paradoxically serve attempted pleasing.
Marriage supplies the domestic field in which allowance and adornment can overlap.

changed_reading.before: God permits a neutral object that the addressee then refuses.
changed_reading.after: At a secondary resonance, the addressee strips an allowed adornment or beautifying good from married life in the very effort to please within it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it chains two distinct ي م ن branches across distant context uses, oath in 66:2 and right side in 66:8. It remains anchored through the focus inventory's oath-release branch under ح ل ل and the focus ending in forgiveness. Downstream prose should render it as a polysemous trajectory from binding to illuminated agency, not as a claim that oath and right hand have one contextual meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes divine release under ح ل ل with غ ف ر, which later frame the two ي م ن uses.

activation_trace.role: Release from an oath anchors the later polysemous chain in the focus's allowance root.
Protective forgiveness anchors the chain's restorative endpoint in the focus.
The sworn oath supplies the binding hand of the trajectory.
The right hand and rightward direction transform the same root into oriented agency after release and return.
Illumination makes the later right side a visible, guided endpoint rather than another bond.
The repeated request for protective forgiveness closes the trajectory with the focus's final root.

changed_reading.before: Release from the focus restriction merely restores access to an object.
changed_reading.after: A contained wordplay lets released oath-bound agency reappear later as a right side accompanied by light and forgiveness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers bodily and architectural images from 66:12 into the legal-affective boundary of 66:1. It remains anchored in the focus opposition between a protected precinct and an untied opening, while 66:12 supplies fortress, aperture, breath, and life in sequence. Downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy about authorized permeability, never as a claim that 66:1 refers to Mary or to the bodily scene.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus opposes human cordoning under ح ر م to divine opening under ح ل ل.

activation_trace.role: A sanctuary and surrounding precinct supply the focus's enclosed boundary.
Untying a knot supplies an opening operation without abolishing all structure.
Preservation inside a surrounding fortress supplies a legitimate guarded boundary.
An opening or gap supplies the aperture held within that guarded structure.
Sending wind into something supplies authorized passage across the guarded aperture.
Life-bearing spirit supplies the beneficial result of that authorized passage.

changed_reading.before: The focus offers a binary choice between a closed prohibition and an open permission.
changed_reading.after: A legitimate boundary can be selectively permeable: guarding remains, but it must admit what divine authorization sends through.

strongest_changes: 66:2 converts the focus restriction into oath-like self-binding with an authorized release procedure.
66:3-4 recast appeasement as management of leaked information and intimate coalition pressure.
66:6 and 66:9 relocate and calibrate firmness by target and divine command rather than rejecting boundaries outright.
66:10-11 establish that marriage joins agents without transferring or merging their moral standing.
66:8 expands the focus ending from reassurance into a branch-backed sequence of mending, covering, relighting, and completion.
summary.what_was_special: The packet supported several coexisting registers at once: legal release, relational bargaining, information control, alliance geometry, protective architecture, and restorative textile imagery. Its split and remote branch images also kept live three readings a conservative synthesis would likely lose: permission resonating as adornment, غ ف ر projecting a sweet tree-exudate image back toward the unspecified object, and guarded openness modeling authorized permeability.
remaining_uncertainties: 66:2 may identify the mechanism of the focus act, or it may only provide a general remedy after it.
The secrecy and coalition sequence may causally explain the prohibition, but adjacency alone does not prove that arrow.
The adornment, sweet-exudate, oath-to-right-side, textile, and selective-permeability readings are branch-distant resonances and must remain explicitly exploratory.
The focus leaves مَا unspecified, so no material image should displace the legal, affective, or other coexisting readings.
